title: Order edits failing
summary: Order edits began failing at ~13:35 UTC with a NullPointerException in AmendOrderHandler.validate after the orders‑service v2.15.0 deploy (commit e4a91c2) at 13:31 UTC. The error rate on orders‑service jumped from ~0.2 % to >4 % while latency stayed flat, and edge‑gateway returned 5xx on /v1/orders. Two plausible explanations remain: (1) the new amendment endpoint lacks a null‑check on a price/quantity field (code regression, HYP‑1) and (2) a subset of existing open orders have NULL limitPrice/quantity, which the new validator now dereferences (data issue, HYP‑2). The investigation was stopped after two rounds because the full file‑level diff for the commit was not retrieved (GAP‑11) and the database could not be queried for NULL values, leaving both hypotheses unruled‑out. The outcome is therefore inconclusive.

hypothesis.mechanism: The v2.15.0 deploy added a new order‑amendment endpoint. In AmendOrderHandler.validate a null‑check on a price/quantity field (e.g., order.limitPrice) was omitted. Every PATCH /v1/orders request that touches an order with that field null throws a NullPointerException, which bubbles up as HTTP 500 to edge‑gateway, producing the observed edit‑failure spike.
predictions: Full diff of commit e4a91c2 will show a missing null‑check in AmendOrderHandler.validate
Orders‑service metrics will show a sharp error‑rate spike without latency or saturation increase

objections.detail: The full file‑level diff for commit e4a91c2 (the missing null‑check in AmendOrderHandler.validate) has not been retrieved (GAP‑11). Without it we cannot confirm the code regression.
HYP‑2 (data issue) offers an equally plausible explanation for the NPE and has not been ruled out.

hypothesis.mechanism: The new amendment endpoint validates fields that older endpoints ignored (e.g., limitPrice). A subset of existing open orders have that column set to NULL in Postgres. When the new validator runs it dereferences the null value, causing the NPE. The deploy is the trigger because the validation logic did not exist before.
predictions: DB query will reveal at least one open order with NULL limitPrice or quantity
Validator code lacks a defensive null guard for that field

objections.detail: Database contents (NULL limitPrice/quantity on open orders) cannot be queried with the available tooling; this evidence gap is a limitation rather than a blockable tool query.
HYP‑1 (code regression) also explains the observations and has not been excluded.

hypothesis.mechanism: The deploy also shipped an undeclared configuration change (e.g., a feature‑flag default or thread‑pool size) that altered the request‑processing pipeline, causing the validator to be invoked with a partially‑initialized request object, leading to the NPE.
predictions: Commit diff will contain a configuration file change or new feature‑flag default
Runtime config inspection will show the new setting active after 13:31 UTC

objections.detail: Change census shows no config change in the relevant window (OBS‑8, OBS‑22), directly contradicting the claim of an undeclared config change.

facts.statement: deploy on orders-service at 13:31:20 UTC by ci/deploy-bot: orders-service v2.15.0: add order amendment endpoint (version: 2.15.0, previous_version: 2.14.3, commit: e4a91c2, diff: +296 / -41)
orders‑service logs show a NullPointerException in AmendOrderHandler.validate (PATCH /v1/orders/<order>) starting at 2026-10-05T13:33:01.127Z, occurring 413 times through 13:57:50Z.
edge‑gateway logs show upstream orders‑service returning 500 on route /v1/orders starting at 2026-10-05T13:34:05.896Z, 379 occurrences through 13:57:54Z.
edge‑gateway error_rate rises from a baseline mean of 0.0020 to a period mean of 0.0045 (max 0.0118) during the window, with the last recorded value at 0.0077.
No other changes (deploy, config, feature‑flag, secret rotation, infra) were recorded for edge‑gateway, market‑data‑service, quotes‑vendor, or postgres‑orders in the 12:50‑13:58 UTC window.
orders‑service error_rate jumps from ~0.002 at 13:30‑13:32 to >0.04 beginning at 13:33, reaching a max of 0.066 at 13:45 and staying elevated through 13:54 (baseline_mean = 0.00186).
orders‑service latency_p99_ms remains stable, ranging 209‑304 ms with a period mean of 263 ms versus a baseline_mean of 260 ms; no latency spike coincides with the error‑rate rise.
The deploy timestamp precedes the first observed NullPointerException in AmendOrderHandler.validate (13:33:01Z) and the increase in edge‑gateway 5xx on /v1/orders (13:34:05Z).
Hard‑dependency chain confirmed: edge‑gateway → orders‑service (hard). Therefore any failure in orders‑service propagates directly to the gateway.

No other production changes (deploy, config, feature‑flag, secret‑rotation, infra) were recorded for orders‑service, edge‑gateway, market‑data‑service, quotes‑vendor, or postgres‑orders in the 12:50‑13:58 UTC window besides the above deploy.
